OPEN_HAND.description: 5 fingers fully extended and spread (Namaste base / 5)

FIST.description: All fingers tightly curled into palm, thumb over fingers (A / S)

POINTING.description: Index extended straight up, all other digits curled (1 / You / Me)

VICTORY_V.description: Index and Middle extended in V-shape, others curled (2 / Peace / V)

THUMBS_UP.description: Thumb pointing straight up, fingers closed in fist (Yes / Good)

THUMBS_DOWN.description: Thumb inverted pointing straight down (No / Bad)

OK_SIGN.description: Thumb and Index fingertips touching in a ring, Middle/Ring/Pinky extended (F / OK)

ILY_LOVE.description: Thumb, Index, and Pinky extended; Middle and Ring curled (I Love You)

LETTER_B.description: 4 fingers straight up touching side-by-side, thumb tucked across palm

LETTER_C.description: Hand curved into a hollow C arc facing forward

LETTER_D.description: Index points straight up, middle/ring/pinky tips touch thumb tip to form an O

LETTER_E.description: All fingers bent tightly down touching palm surface, thumb tucked underneath

LETTER_I.description: Pinky straight up, other 3 fingers curled into fist, thumb tucked across (Pinky / 10)

LETTER_K.description: Index straight up, Middle angled forward 45 deg, Thumb tucked between them

LETTER_L.description: Thumb and Index at 90-degree right angle, other 3 fingers curled (L)

LETTER_O.description: All five fingertips curved and touching tips, forming an oval O profile

LETTER_R.description: Index and Middle fingers extended and crossed over each other

LETTER_U.description: Index and Middle fingers held strictly straight together touching side-by-side

LETTER_W.description: Index, Middle, and Ring extended spread out in a W, Thumb holds Pinky down (3)

LETTER_Y.description: Thumb and Pinky extended outward; 3 middle fingers curled in fist (Call Me / Y)

FOUR_FINGERS.description: 4 fingers straight up spread, thumb folded inward over the palm (4)

GUN_POINT.description: Thumb pointing straight up, Index pointing forward/horizontally (Gun)

CLAW_HAND.description: 5 fingers curved like an animal claw (C-shape fingers spread apart)

FLAT_HAND_CHOP.description: 4 fingers straight together pointing straight forward/sideways, thumb along index (B / Salute)

PINCH_FLAT.description: All 5 fingertips touching together forming a flower bud / closed beak (More / Eat)
